answers.assumption_check: Load-bearing: the seal's evidence.conditions dict (conditions.measure) is the right place; it already records interpreter, isolation, timeout and CAIRN_ env digests, and compare()/changed() already flag a key that differs between a red and the green that replaces it. Measured: test_installer.json's conditions hold 'interpreter: C:\Users\akien\.cairn\venv\Scripts\python.exe 3.14.4' but no platform key; the platform is only guessable from the backslashes. Not assumed: that records sealed before this ticket carry the key; changed() compares only keys on both sides, so old records never notify by themselves.
answers.builder_check: A Haiku builder needs: the file (cairn/devices/tester/conditions.py measure()), the exact key and format (platform: '<sys.platform> <platform.machine()>'), that changed() needs no edit, and two teeth that import the tester inside their body like test_a_green_over_a_red_under_other_conditions_notifies.py does. The ticket carries all of these.
answers.children: none, because the fix is one key in one function and one proof
answers.collision_check: Looked at f0aad0cd0f56 (conditions instrument and notices: this adds one key to its record and relies on its compare/changed unchanged) and 8383a32d20c5 (the timeout is recorded but not compared; unaffected). No collision. Existing seals lack the key; changed() compares only keys on both sides, so none of them notify.
answers.falsifier_check: Clauses: (1) measure() returns a 'platform' condition equal to sys.platform and the machine, for any proof | (2) changed() reports 'platform' when a red recorded on one platform is replaced by a green recorded on another, so the existing notice names it. Horizon: red against HEAD (no platform key), green after.
answers.gates_bound: proof gate (a hollow build must fail it) + durability gate (committed) + feeds-back-to-origin on failure (Laws 3 + 8).
answers.missing_check: Not wrapped: whether to also record that a forced newline or other interpreter-level doctoring was active (orchestrator's worry: a seal under a forced LF is a different measurement). Measured today: no sitecustomize LF force is installed on this box, so there is nothing to record yet; the platform key is the part that can be measured now. A force, if one returns, would be a second condition key and its own ticket.

bullets.text: A seal now records its platform; today ten Windows seals since 11-11 name no box, so nobody can tell whether a tooth was ever green on Windows.
